official_text: Adoption by Board of Education, upon recommendation of the Measure N Commission, of a 2021-2022 budget modification request from Skyline High School transferring $9,000.00, from Facility Rental (no impact -we still hope to do the original strategic action) to Textbooks, for a new total amount of $15,000.00, as stated in the justification section of the New or Revised Strategic Action Section of the Budget Modification Form.
presenter: Measure N - College and Career Readiness Commission
headline: Moves $9,000 at Skyline High from facility rental to textbooks under Measure N
summary: The Board is asked to approve a 2021-2022 budget change for Skyline High School, as recommended by the Measure N Commission. It moves $9,000 from the facility rental line to the textbooks line, which then totals $15,000. The school says the move has no impact because it still hopes to carry out its original plan.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Agreement for Architectural Services – Perkins Eastman Architects – McClymonds High School Site Renovation Project – Division of Facilities Planning and Management
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of Agreement for Architectural Services by and between the District and Perkins Eastman Architects DPC, Oakland, CA, for the latter to provide architectural services, as described in Articles 5 and 6 of Agreement, incorporated herein by reference as though fully set forth, for the design-build McClymonds High School Site Renovation Project, in the not to-exceed amount of $1,234,302.00, which includes a not-to-exceed amount of $107,936.00 for additional services, a not-to-exceed amount of $47,000.00 for reimbursable expenses, as the selected consultant, with work scheduled to commence on October 28, 2021, and scheduled to last until July 31, 2025.
presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
headline: Approves up to $1.23M for Perkins Eastman to design McClymonds High renovation
summary: The district would hire Perkins Eastman Architects to provide architectural services for the design-build renovation of McClymonds High School, for no more than $1,234,302. That includes up to $107,936 for additional services and up to $47,000 for reimbursable expenses. Work is scheduled to run from October 28, 2021 to July 31, 2025.
pulled_from_consent: Adopted in its own vote at this meeting (7–0), instead of with the rest of the consent report.
outcome_action: Adopted
